projects.name: Multi-Platform Chatbot with Qlik Sense Integration
projects.description: Chatbot system that fetches live charts and KPIs from Qlik Sense and delivers them across Microsoft Teams, Google Assistant, Alexa, WhatsApp, and Telegram from a single backend.
projects.impact: Reduced ad-hoc BI reporting requests by enabling self-serve data access via conversational interfaces.
projects.tech: Node.js, Qlik Sense API, Dialogflow, Alexa Skills Kit, MS Bot Framework, WhatsApp API, Telegram API

projects.name: DataAccessAuditor Portal
projects.description: Full Qlik Sense Section Access management portal with role-based access control, audit logging, and data security enforcement for enterprise governance.
projects.impact: Ships as a Windows app that validates QMC rules, data-connection, session and sheet-level access per user.

projects.name: Video Framer
projects.description: Video generation system using FFMPEG that overlays doctor photos and names onto promotional videos, enabling personalised content at scale for medical field representatives.
projects.impact: Reduced manual video editing effort to zero; output generated programmatically on demand.

projects.name: Employee Dashboard
projects.description: Analytics dashboard tracking employee output (artwork, video, content, web) across monthly, yearly and custom date ranges with artist-level and division-level drill-downs.

projects.name: Resync – Medical Education Platform
projects.description: Platform allowing doctors to consume instructional videos and complete post-watch quizzes, supporting continuous medical education (CME) compliance tracking.

projects.name: Tableau-to-Power BI Migration Tool
projects.description: Automated conversion of Tableau scripts to Power BI using LLM-assisted transformation pipelines.
projects.impact: Cut migration effort by ~60% versus a manual rewrite.

projects.name: Log Cluster – Log Visualisation Tool
projects.description: Web app to cluster and visualise large-scale log data from Elasticsearch.
projects.impact: Dramatically cut mean-time-to-diagnose (MTTD) for operations teams.

projects.name: Qlik Sense Annotation Extension
projects.description: Extension enabling object and chart-level annotations inside Qlik Sense dashboards, improving collaborative data storytelling for enterprise clients.
projects.tech: Node.js, AngularJS, Qlik Sense Extension API

projects.name: SaaS License Management System
projects.description: Machine-locked license generation and validation system for SaaS products, binding each license cryptographically to the target hardware fingerprint.

projects.name: Wowizer Windows Service
projects.description: Production-grade Windows installer and background service built with InnoSetup and Pascal, with secure API key handling and auto-startup via NSSM.

projects.name: Multiplex Video Streaming Platform
projects.description: Full OTT platform where channel owners upload movies and web series; videos are transcoded via Bunny API into HLS for adaptive streaming on Android and web.

projects.name: Meta Ads API Automation & Chatbot Integration
projects.description: Integrated Meta Ads API into a client chatbot for campaign data fetch, performance reporting and automated OAuth token renewal.

projects.name: AI Voice Agent Call Transfer System
projects.description: Dynamic voice-based agent transfer workflow connecting ChatBotBuilder with Retell, enabling real-time call escalation from chatbot to human agents in a contact centre.
